column1: # Astronomical-scale shadows (rings, eclipses, transits) are analytic; see IVSunOcclusionManager.
# The far light has no shadow map. Near/middle maps serve the local scene only: casters carry the
# LOCAL_SHADOW_CASTER layer bit (see IVGlobal), and apply_sun_occlusion dims these lights by the
# camera-point sun-visible fraction (eclipse/ring shadowing of craft-scale objects).
# The first row naming a star is its top light, whose energy the rings and atmospheres also read
# (IVDynamicLight.star_light_energies); it must not take apply_sun_occlusion. Under the
# Compatibility renderer the shadowed rows drop their maps unless
# IVCoreSettings.apply_gl_compatibility_shadows keeps them; each row still lights its own domain.
